traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Repulsion Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6). Dexterity Saving

actions.name: Throw
actions.text: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot- wide Line. Failure: 49 (9d10) Lightning damage. Suc- cess: Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 40 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition. Adult Bronze Dragon

legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Guiding Light
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendaryActions.name: Thunderclap
legendaryActions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6)
